name: horror-day

color_bins.note: Raised from 28 (2026-11-27, maintainer): 28 was calibrated on flat cartoon reels (10-21 bins); filmic frames with grain and soft gradients measure 31-37 with a disciplined palette (Upper Berth v2). Palette discipline stays enforced by hue_families <= 3.

_note: Daylight horror (bright allowed, no mean_luma ceiling). The look still needs true blacks (p5_luma max), punchy contrast, saturation and a subject >= 22% of frame height. Calibrated on Zero Shadow Day: strong shots s2_dadi/s6_raju/s7_whisper p5 20-55; bleached courtyard shots p5 144-171. See references/visual-loop.md.
